items.title_en: Write code like a human will maintain it
items.title_zh: 写出人类也能维护的代码
items.summary_en: The piece argues for writing code that humans can maintain, not just clever or hard-to-understand solutions. It emphasizes readability, clear naming, modular structure, and tests as safeguards against future bugs. The takeaway is that maintainability is a design constraint, not an afterthought.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张编写便于人类维护的代码，而非追逐炫技或难以理解的实现。强调可读性、清晰命名、模块化结构与测试等作为对未来缺陷的防线。核心观点是可维护性应成为设计约束而非事后考虑。

items.title_en: Punk, or why I don't stream anymore
items.title_zh: 朋克，或者为什么我不再直播
items.summary_en: A personal reflection on streaming culture, burnout, or policy concerns that led the author to stop streaming. It touches on privacy, community dynamics, and sustainability of creator work.
items.summary_zh: 作者就流媒体文化、职业疲劳或平台政策等问题进行反思，解释为何不再进行直播。文中涉及隐私、社区关系以及创作者工作的可持续性等议题。

items.title_en: Late Bronze Age Collapse
items.title_zh: 晚青铜时代崩溃
items.summary_en: The Late Bronze Age collapse refers to a complex, multi-state disruption around 1200 BCE. The post offers a concise introduction to prevailing theories—from drought and famine to invasions and trade breakdown. It matters because it informs how interconnected civilizations can fail, a topic with resonance for modern supply chains and risk management.
items.summary_zh: 晚青铜时代崩溃指的是公元前约1200年的多国共同性崩溃，理论包括干旱、饥荒、入侵与贸易网络破裂等。该简介帮助理解为何高度互联的文明体系会崩溃，这对当今的供应链与风险管理仍具启示意义。

items.title_en: EU Commission: addictive design Instagram and Facebook in breach of the DSA
items.title_zh: 欧盟委员会：Instagram 与 Facebook 的成瘾设计违反 DSA
items.summary_en: The European Commission finds addictive design elements in Instagram and Facebook to breach the Digital Services Act, signaling a regulatory push against design choices that encourage prolonged use. The decision could push product teams to rethink engagement tactics and algorithmic incentives.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟委员会认定 Instagram 与 Facebook 的成瘾性设计违反《数字服务法》，标志着对促成长期使用的设计做法的监管加强。此举可能促使产品团队重新审视黏性设计与算法激励策略。

items.title_en: QuadRF can spot drones and see WiFi through my wall
items.title_zh: QuadRF 能侦测无人机并穿墙探测 WiFi 信号
items.summary_en: QuadRF demonstrates that RF sensing can reveal both drone activity and WiFi signals through walls. This kind of passive observation highlights security and privacy implications for home networks and aerial devices, even when devices aren't in visible sight. It also underscores practical limits like range, clutter, and legal boundaries.
items.summary_zh: QuadRF 展示了射频探测可以在墙后揭示无人机活动和 WiFi 信号。这类被动观测引发对家庭网络和无人机安全与隐私的担忧，同时也暴露出覆盖范围、信号干扰和法律边界等局限。

items.title_en: GPT-5.6
items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 版本
items.summary_en: A new GPT-5.6 model appears, signaling continued iteration on the GPT-5 family. Expect refinements in reasoning, safety, and efficiency, reflecting the ongoing cadence of large language model updates.
items.summary_zh: GPT-5.6 版正逐步进入，表示 GPT-5 系列的持续迭代。预计在推理、安全与效率方面有改进，体现大语言模型更新的持续节奏。

items.title_en: A Love Letter to Flashcards
items.title_zh: 致敬抽认卡
items.summary_en: A Love Letter to Flashcards praises flashcards as a learning tool, emphasizing spaced repetition and concise prompts. It discusses design choices that make flashcards effective and enduring in modern study workflows.
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章以情感笔触赞扬抽认卡在学习中的作用，强调分散性重复和简短提示的重要性。还讨论了让抽认卡在现代学习流程中高效持久的设计要点。

items.title_en: Good Tools Are Invisible
items.title_zh: 好工具往往无形
items.summary_en: Great tools fade into the background by design, reducing cognitive load and letting people focus on what matters. The piece cautions that invisibility should not hide value from teams and argues for clear outcomes and good integration.
items.summary_zh: 优秀的工具被设计为在工作流中隐形，降低认知负担，让人专注于核心任务。文章提醒不要让它们的价值被忽视，并强调要有清晰的成效与良好的集成。

items.title_en: Successful Companies Go Blind
items.title_zh: 成功的公司会变得盲目
items.summary_en: As companies scale, they can lose sight of fundamentals like customer needs and product quality. The article argues for deliberate checks—maintaining a 'healthy paranoia' about risk, investing in reliability, and keeping feedback loops intact.
items.summary_zh: 企业在快速成长后容易忽视基本面，如客户需求和产品质量。文章提倡保持对风险的健康警觉、加强可靠性建设，并维护有效的反馈循环。

items.title_en: EU Parliament greenlights Chat Control 1.0
items.title_zh: 欧盟议会通过聊天监控1.0，Breyer：我们的孩子要吃亏
items.summary_en: This marks a major push to enable cross-border scanning of encrypted messages in pursuit of child safety and crime prevention. Critics warn that the measure expands surveillance at the expense of privacy and free expression, while Breyer argues that children will lose out.
items.summary_zh: 这标志着推动跨境扫描加密通讯以提升儿童安全和打击犯罪的重大举措。批评者担心此举侵蚀隐私与言论自由，而Breyer则认为这会让儿童吃亏。

items.title_en: Europe's Largest Unions Demand Right to Cancel Work on Days Above 30C
items.title_zh: 欧洲最大的工会要求在气温高于 30°C 时取消工作
items.summary_en: Europe's largest unions push for the right to cancel work on days exceeding 30°C, citing worker safety and climate resilience. The stance signals growing labor activism around extreme heat and could influence workplace policy.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲最大的工会要求在气温超过 30°C 时有权取消工作，以保障工人安全和应对极端高温。此举体现日益增长的劳动行动主义，或影响企业的工作制度与安全政策。

items.title_en: AI-generated videos to maximally drive a target brain region
items.title_zh: AI 生成视频以最大化激活目标脑区
items.summary_en: Researchers are using AI-generated videos to selectively stimulate a target brain region, aiming to drive neural activity more efficiently with visual input. The approach could advance noninvasive brain stimulation and brain–computer interfaces, but it also raises questions about safety, biases in generative models, and ethical implications of neural manipulation.
items.summary_zh: 研究人员利用 AI 生成的视频来有选择地激活某一脑区，试图通过视觉刺激更高效地驱动神经活动。该技术若成熟可推动非侵入性脑刺激和脑机接口的发展，同时也引发关于安全、生成模型偏差与神经操控伦理等问题的讨论。

items.title_en: Show HN: 18 Words
items.title_zh: Show HN: 18 Words
items.summary_en: Show HN: 18 Words introduces a minimal writing tool that limits posts to 18 words, prioritizing brevity and speed. It exemplifies a design philosophy where constraints drive clarity and reduce noise.
items.summary_zh: Show HN: 18 Words 展示了一个极简写作工具，帖子被限制为18个单词，强调简洁与快速分享。此举体现了通过约束提升表达清晰度、降低噪声的设计理念。

items.title_en: ActivityPub over ATProto
items.title_zh: ActivityPub 在 ATProto 上的实现
items.summary_en: Discusses interoperability by running ActivityPub over ATProto, exploring how federated networks could interconnect and what UX implications this would entail.
items.summary_zh: 探讨在 ATProto 上实现 ActivityPub 的互通性，研究联邦网络如何互联以及可能带来的用户体验影响。

items.title_en: In Emacs, Everything Looks Like a Service
items.title_zh: 在 Emacs 中，一切看起来像服务
items.summary_en: An essay arguing for modular, service-like abstractions in Emacs customization to improve composability and testability. It discusses trade-offs between simplicity and modularity and offers practical guidance.
items.summary_zh: 作者主张在 Emacs 的扩展中采用类似服务的模块化抽象，以提升组合性和测试性。讨论了简化与模块化之间的取舍，并给出实际建议。

items.title_en: John Deere owners will get the right to repair equipment under FTC settlement
items.title_zh: FTC和解赋予约翰迪尔设备的修理权
items.summary_en: An FTC settlement grants John Deere equipment owners the right to repair, potentially lowering downtime and repair costs. It signals a shift toward repairability by nudging OEMs to share tools, manuals, and parts, and could boost independent repair shops. This case could influence broader right-to-repair momentum in tech-enabled farming.
items.summary_zh: FTC与约翰迪尔设备修理权的和解，可能降低停机时间与维修成本，推动制造商提供维修工具、手册与零件。此举或促成独立修理商的兴起，或对农业科技领域的修理权运动产生示范效应。

items.title_en: Hy3
items.title_zh: Hy3
items.summary_en: Hy3 is a new AI model introduced by Tencent's research division.
items.summary_zh: Hy3 是腾讯研究部推出的新一代 AI 模型。

items.title_en: Show HN: Getting GLM 5.2 running on my slow computer
items.title_zh: Show HN：在慢速电脑上让 GLM 5.2 运行起来
items.summary_en: A developer documents getting GLM 5.2 to run on a slow machine, sharing practical steps, constraints, and tweaks. It shows how lightweight inference paths and community tooling can unlock usable performance on modest hardware.
items.summary_zh: 开发者记录在慢速计算机上运行 GLM 5.2 的过程，提供具体步骤、限制与调整方法。展示了通过轻量化推理路径和社区工具在中等硬件上也能获得可用性能的可能。

items.title_en: Proton AG Services is currently experiencing some issues
items.title_zh: Proton AG 服务当前出现问题
items.summary_en: Proton AG reports service issues affecting core offerings; outages may impact mail, VPN, and related services. The status page indicates incident details and ETA.
items.summary_zh: Proton AG 相关服务当前出现故障，可能影响 Proton Mail、VPN 等核心服务。状态页公布事故详情及预计修复时间。

items.title_en: Why American ambulance rides are so expensive
items.title_zh: 美国救护车收费为何如此昂贵
items.summary_en: The post dissects why ambulance rides in the U.S. cost so much—from billing practices and insurance gaps to the costs of trained personnel and equipment. It highlights policy and payer dynamics that drive the prices up and affect patients.
items.summary_zh: 文章剖析美国救护车费用居高不下的原因，包括计费方式、保险缺口、人员与设备成本，以及支付者与政策环境的作用，对患者影响深远。

items.title_en: Postgres rewritten in Rust, now passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 重写 PostgreSQL，现已通过 100% 回归测试
items.summary_en: A project to rewrite PostgreSQL components in Rust reports passing all regression tests, signaling Rust's viability for safety-critical system software. While not a drop-in replacement, the effort demonstrates how safer memory management and modern tooling could influence database internals.
items.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重写 PostgreSQL 组件的尝试声称已通过全部回归测试，显示 Rust 在安全性关键系统中的潜力。虽然不是直接的替代，但这项工作展示了更安全的内存管理与现代工具链对数据库内部实现的潜在影响。

items.title_en: The glass backbone: Why the Army's logistics will break in the next war
items.title_zh: 玻璃脊梁：未来战争中陆军后勤为何会崩溃
items.summary_en: The piece argues that modern military logistics rely on a fragile, highly digitized backbone, making supply chains vulnerable in future conflicts. It discusses failure points and resilience strategies like redundancy and decentralization.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为现代军事后勤以脆弱、高度数字化的骨干为支撑，在未来冲突中极易受到干扰。文中分析潜在崩溃点，并提出通过冗余、去中心化等方式提升韧性的思路。

items.title_en: ChatGPT Work
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 在工作中的应用
items.summary_en: OpenAI positions ChatGPT as a tool for ambitious work, highlighting capabilities for drafting, research, and collaboration in professional contexts. The messaging signals a push to position ChatGPT as a productivity platform for teams.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 ChatGPT 定位为高强度工作场景的工具，突出草拟、研究与协作等功能在专业环境中的应用。此举标志着将 ChatGPT 打造成团队生产力平台的市场策略。

items.title_en: Interview with Mitchell Hashimoto about Ghostty and Zig
items.title_zh: Mitchell Hashimoto 对 Ghostty 与 Zig 的访谈
items.summary_en: Mitchell Hashimoto discusses the Ghostty project and the Zig language, focusing on design decisions, safety, and how these tools fit into modern DevOps and systems work. It offers perspective on building resilient tooling outside mainstream ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 与 Mitchell Hashimoto 就 Ghostty 项目与 Zig 语言进行对话，聚焦设计抉择、安全性以及在现代开发运维和系统工作中的应用前景，提供对打造稳健工具生态的观点。

items.title_en: Show HN: Runloom – Go-style coroutines for Python free-threaded
items.title_zh: Show HN: Runloom——为 Python 提供 Go 风格的协程
items.summary_en: Runloom brings Go-style coroutines to Python, enabling more approachable concurrency without heavy threading. It could ease async programming for Python developers and spark new patterns for parallel tasks.
items.summary_zh: Runloom 将 Go 风格的协程带进 Python，使并发编程更加友好，减少对多线程的痛点。对 Python 开发者的异步编程或将带来更易用的新范式。

items.title_en: Muse Spark 1.1
items.title_zh: Muse Spark 1.1 推出
items.summary_en: Meta announces Muse Spark 1.1, an API for deploying and managing models, improving tooling for developers and end-to-end workflows.
items.summary_zh: Meta 公布 Muse Spark 1.1，为开发者提供部署与管理模型的 API，提升工具链与端到端工作流的体验。

items.title_en: Unified Memory, Explained: Why Mini PCs Can Run 70B Models a Big GPU Can't
items.title_zh: 统一内存解析：为何小型 PC 能跑 70B 参数模型，而大型GPU 做不到
items.summary_en: Explains how unified memory architectures enable small form-factor PCs to run very large models, while GPUs face memory and bandwidth bottlenecks. Also discusses practical edge-AI implications and trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 解释统一内存架构如何让小型 PC 也能运行极大模型，而 GPU 则受制于显存和带宽瓶颈，并讨论在边缘 AI 场景的权衡。

items.title_en: Parental device use and the adolescent-caregiver attachment bond
items.title_zh: 父母设备使用与青少年-照护者依恋关系
items.summary_en: The study investigates how parental device usage during interactions relates to the adolescent-caregiver attachment bond, finding that higher screen usage is linked to weaker attachment quality and less responsive parenting. The findings highlight the fragility of the parent-child bond in the digital era and suggest strategies for mindful tech use at home.
items.summary_zh: 研究探讨了父母在互动中使用电子设备对青少年照护者依恋关系的影响，结果显示高屏幕使用与依恋质量下降和反应性下降相关。研究强调数字时代家庭关系的脆弱性，并提出在家庭中实行更有意识的科技使用的策略。

items.title_en: A possible future for Damn Interesting
items.title_zh: Damn Interesting 的未来可能走向
items.summary_en: The article speculates on how Damn Interesting could evolve in the AI era, potentially adopting new formats and monetization models while preserving its science storytelling focus. It weighs challenges like audience fragmentation and sustainable funding.
items.summary_zh: 本文对 Damn Interesting 在 AI 时代的未来走向进行了设想，探讨其在维持科普叙事的同时可能采用的新格式与盈利模式。文章也讨论了观众分化与长期资金可持续性等挑战。

items.title_en: Garnix Is Joining Shopify
items.title_zh: Garnix 将加入 Shopify
items.summary_en: Garnix joining Shopify signals a move to deepen Shopify's ecosystem with external tooling. This could streamline automation and AI workflows for merchants and reduce integration friction for developers.
items.summary_zh: Garnix 加入 Shopify，表示 Shopify 将通过外部工具扩展生态系统。这可能帮助商家实现更高效的自动化与 AI 工作流，并降低开发者的集成成本。

items.title_en: No leap second will be introduced at the end of December 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年底将不再加入闰秒
items.summary_en: The International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service confirms no leap second will be added at the end of 2026. This continues a trend toward simpler, predictable timekeeping for distributed systems. Engineers should plan around a leap-second-free timeline while staying alert for policy updates.
items.summary_zh: 国际时刻参考系统宣布 2026 年底不再添加闰秒。这延续了简化且可预测的全球时间计量趋势，便于分布式系统的时钟同步。工程师应在无闰秒的时间线下开展计划，并关注未来的政策变动。

items.title_en: GLM 5.2 is nearly as accurate as a human book keeper
items.title_zh: GLM 5.2 的准确度几乎达到人类簿记员水平
items.summary_en: GLM 5.2 achieves VAT benchmark accuracy close to human bookkeepers, showing AI's growing competence in financial tasks. This underscores how automated accounting could reshape back-office operations, prompting discussions on reliability and controls.
items.summary_zh: GLM 5.2 在 VAT 基准测试中的表现接近人类簿记员的水平，体现了 AI 在财务任务上的进步。这将推动自动化记账改变后台运营，同时引发关于可靠性与审控的讨论。

items.title_en: A road to Lisp: Why Lisp
items.title_zh: 走向 Lisp 的路：为何学习 Lisp
items.summary_en: Explores why Lisp remains relevant: powerful macros, homoiconicity, and influence on modern language design and tooling.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 Lisp 仍具相关性的原因：强大的宏、同构性以及对现代语言设计和工具链的影响。

items.title_en: AI content is everywhere on social media, especially LinkedIn
items.title_zh: 社交媒体上的 AI 内容无处不在，LinkedIn 尤为明显
items.summary_en: AI-generated content is proliferating across social media, with LinkedIn showing a particularly high share. This trend accelerates content production for professionals but also challenges readers to assess authenticity and credibility. Platform policies and signal reliability will be key to preserving trust as feeds become more automated.
items.summary_zh: AI 生成的内容正在社交媒体中迅速蔓延，LinkedIn 的表现尤为突出。这一趋势提高了专业内容的产出效率，同时也让读者在辨别真实性和可信度方面面临挑战。平台的信号质量与监管政策将决定在日益自动化的信息流中的信任水平。

items.title_en: Computation as a Universal and Fundamental Concept
items.title_zh: 计算被视为普遍且基本的概念
items.summary_en: A discussion framing computation as a universal, fundamental idea that underpins sciences, math, and engineering. It promotes computational thinking as a cross-disciplinary literacy.
items.summary_zh: 讨论将计算视为跨科普与工程等领域的普遍、基础的概念，倡导计算思维作为跨学科的基础素养。

items.title_en: Focus
items.title_zh: 专注
items.summary_en: Offers practical guidance on cultivating focus amid distractions, emphasizing deep work, routines, and minimizing context switching. It argues sustained attention yields higher-quality outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 提供在分心环境下培养专注力的实用建议，强调深度工作、日常作息和减少情境切换。指出持续的专注能带来更高质量的成果。

items.title_en: Building a real-time AI tutor for 5-year-olds
items.title_zh: 为5岁儿童构建实时 AI 导师
items.summary_en: Describes building a real-time AI tutor for five-year-olds with sub-second response times, focusing on safety, age-appropriate guidance, and engaging interactions. The project highlights latency-aware UX and the challenges of teaching preschoolers with AI under developmental safeguards.
items.summary_zh: 介绍为5岁儿童构建实时 AI 导师的尝试，关注安全、年龄适宜的引导以及互动性，强调对低延迟用户体验的追求和在发展阶段设限的挑战。

items.title_en: TLS certificates for internal services done right
items.title_zh: 内部服务的 TLS 证书正确配置
items.summary_en: Best practices for issuing and rotating TLS certificates for internal services, emphasizing automation, short-lived certs, and mTLS between services. Proper internal PKI reduces risk and improves security for service-to-service communication.
items.summary_zh: 内部服务 TLS 证书的最佳实践，聚焦自动化、短期证书和服务间 mTLS。健全的内部公钥基础设施能降低横向渗透风险，提升微服务间通信的安全性。

items.title_en: Ben Bernanke Joins Anthropic Oversight Trust
items.title_zh: 本·伯南克加入 Anthropic 监督信托
items.summary_en: Former Fed chair Ben Bernanke joins Anthropic's Oversight Trust to help guide responsible AI development. The move signals growing involvement of policymakers in AI governance, potentially shaping oversight standards, risk assessment, and collaboration with industry.
items.summary_zh: 前美联储主席本·伯南克加入 Anthropic 的监督信托，协助引导负责任的人工智能开发。此举体现了政策制定者在 AI 治理中的日益介入，或影响监督标准、风险评估及与业界的合作方式。

items.title_en: Opinionated and easy Pi.dev configuration
items.title_zh: 对 Pi.dev 配置的主张式与易用性
items.summary_en: The post argues for an opinionated, easy-to-use configuration style for Pi.dev, emphasizing sensible defaults and developer ergonomics. The goal is to reduce cognitive load while keeping builds predictable.
items.summary_zh: 本文主张为 Pi.dev 提供更为固定化、易用的配置风格，强调合理的默认选项与开发者体验。目标是在降低认知负担的同时保持构建的可预测性。

items.title_en: Launch HN: Context.dev (YC S26) – API to get structured data from any website
items.title_zh: Context.dev（YC S26）——从任意网站获取结构化数据的 API
items.summary_en: Context.dev provides an API to extract structured data from any website, enabling agents and tools to reason over web content without bespoke scrapers. It promises easier data extraction but raises questions about data licensing and reliability.
items.summary_zh: Context.dev 提供一个从任意网站提取结构化数据的 API，使代理和工具能够基于网页内容进行推理，而无需定制爬虫。它让数据提取更便捷，但也对数据许可与可靠性提出了相关疑问。

items.title_en: Build your own vulnerability harness
items.title_zh: 搭建你自己的漏洞利用框架
items.summary_en: Guides building a vulnerability harness for testing exploit scenarios, emphasizing isolation, logging, and reproducibility. The post outlines safe, authorized ways to design such a harness and covers practical steps and trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 提供搭建漏洞利用框架进行安全测试的指南，强调隔离、日志记录与可重复性。内容讲解在获得授权的前提下如何设计和使用此类框架，以及相关的实践要点与取舍。

items.title_en: Show HN: Analog Watch
items.title_zh: Show HN：模拟手表
items.summary_en: Show HN introduces Analog Watch, a hardware project showcasing a traditional-timepiece approach with modern hardware or features.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示了模拟手表，这是一个硬件项目，强调传统模拟表的工艺美感，并结合现代硬件特性。

items.title_en: SimPolitics: America’s quest to solve politics with computers
items.title_zh: SimPolitics：美国用电脑解决政治的探索
items.summary_en: SimPolitics surveys attempts to use computation to model and influence politics, weighing benefits and risks of data-driven governance. It discusses what simulations can and cannot achieve in democratic decision-making.
items.summary_zh: 《SimPolitics》梳理以计算方法建模和影响政治的尝试，评估数据驱动治理的益处与风险，探讨仿真在民主决策中的成效与局限。

items.title_en: Star Just Ate a Planet, and It's Not Done Yet
items.title_zh: 恒星吞噬行星，尚未结束
items.summary_en: Astronomers report a star that has engulfed a planet, an ongoing event that offers a rare glimpse into planetary-system dynamics and stellar evolution. The observation underscores how star-planet interactions shape the fate of worlds and informs models of exoplanetary systems.
items.summary_zh: 天文学家观测到一颗恒星吞噬行星的过程，仍在继续，提供了关于行星系统动力学和恒星演化的罕见线索。此类星-行星相互作用对于理解行星命运与系外行星系统的模型具有重要意义。

items.title_en: DeepSeek aims to make its own AI chip
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 打算自研 AI 芯片
items.summary_en: DeepSeek pivots to developing its own AI silicon, signaling a bold hardware strategy in a competitive AI chip landscape.
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 转向自研 AI 芯片，代表在竞争激烈的AI芯片领域采取的大胆硬件策略。

items.title_en: Train sim created by just one person is being called the best ever made
items.title_zh: 单人开发的铁路模拟游戏被誉为最出色的作品
items.summary_en: A solo developer's train simulator has earned near-universal praise, illustrating how focused scope and polish can rival big studio productions. It underscores indie grit and the potential of passion-driven, high-quality simulations.
items.summary_zh: 一名独立开发者打造的铁路模拟游戏获得广泛赞誉，显示出专注与打磨同样能与大厂作品竞争，凸显独立开发者的韧性与高质量仿真潜力。

items.title_en: The Annotated JEPA
items.title_zh: JEPA 的注解版
items.summary_en: Annotated JEPA provides commentary to help readers understand the original text, with clarifications and context for modern audiences.
items.summary_zh: JEPA 的注释版为读者提供额外的注释与背景，帮助现代读者理解原文内容。

items.title_en: What's slowing down the AI buildout
items.title_zh: AI 推进为何受阻？
items.summary_en: The AI buildout is slowed by grid and energy constraints, requiring improvements in hardware efficiency and data-center infrastructure. The article argues that power and cooling, not just compute, bottleneck AI deployment.
items.summary_zh: AI 推进受限于电网和能源约束，需要提升硬件效率与数据中心基础设施。文章强调功率与冷却等因素，而非仅仅是计算能力，是 AI 部署的瓶颈。

items.title_en: Show HN: I mapped 8.5M research papers into an interactive atlas
items.title_zh: Show HN：将 850 万篇研究论文映射成一个交互式图谱
items.summary_en: A Show HN project maps 8.5 million research papers into an interactive atlas, enabling new ways to explore scholarly literature and discover connections across fields. It serves as a powerful dataset explorer for researchers and educators.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 项目将 850 万篇研究论文映射到一个交互式图谱，帮助用户以全新方式探索学术文献并发现跨学科关联。对研究人员和教育工作者来说，这是一个强大的数据集探索工具。

items.title_en: My burner email blocklist blocked me
items.title_zh: 我的临时邮箱黑名单把我挡住了
items.summary_en: A personal account of being blocked by a burner email blocklist, illustrating how automated abuse-prevention systems can lock out legitimate users. It highlights the tension between security and usability and suggests that more nuanced verification could help both sides.
items.summary_zh: 作者因使用一次性邮箱被黑名单拦截，说明自动防 abuse 系统有时会误伤正常用户。强调安全与可用性之间的矛盾，并建议采用更细致的验证策略。

items.title_en: Buried Apple feature turns an iPhone into the perfect kids' dumb phone
items.title_zh: 隐藏的苹果功能将 iPhone 变为理想的儿童简易机
items.summary_en: A hidden iOS feature lets parents limit calls, messages, and apps to turn an iPhone into a simple device for kids. The move highlights ongoing consumer control and parental safety tradeoffs as smartphones become everyday tools.
items.summary_zh: 隐藏的 iOS 功能允许家长限制通话、信息和应用，将 iPhone 打造成简单的儿童设备。这一举措凸显了在智能手机日益普及的同时，用户控制与安全的权衡。

items.title_en: Show HN: Rubiks Cube Solver
items.title_zh: Show HN：魔方求解器
items.summary_en: Show HN: Rubiks Cube Solver presents a solver with a live demo and explanation of the algorithm behind solving the cube, likely leveraging established methods or novel optimization. It highlights how combinatorial search techniques translate into practical, fast solvers.
items.summary_zh: Show HN：魔方求解器展示了一个可演示的求解器及其求解算法的实现，可能基于既有方法或经过优化的方案。体现了组合搜索技术如何落地为实用且高效的求解器。

items.title_en: I Built the Only 2026 WWII Jeep
items.title_zh: 我打造了唯一的2026年款二战吉普
items.summary_en: A single-minded build documents a audacious project: a 2026-era WWII Jeep constructed against steep odds, including supply-chain and safety challenges. The effort shows how modern fabrication methods and entrepreneurial risk intersect in ambitious hardware projects.
items.summary_zh: 一位热衷构建者记录了一项极具野心的尝试：打造一辆2026年款的二战吉普，面对供应链、安全性和历史还原等重重挑战。此举展示了现代制造工艺、原型开发与企业级硬件项目风险如何交织。

items.title_en: Almost Always Unsigned
items.title_zh: 几乎总是未签名
items.summary_en: A concise meditation on when unsigned data types or unsigned contexts are the right default in software, highlighting why unsigned values are often used in practice.
items.summary_zh: 对在软件中何时默认使用未签名数据类型或上下文的一种简短思考，强调在实际场景中未签名数值为何常被采用。

items.title_en: Girls just wanna have fast MPMC queues with bounded waiting
items.title_zh: 带有界等待的高速 MPMC 队列
items.summary_en: Research presents fast MPMC queues with bounded waiting, addressing a key bottleneck in concurrent data structures. The work offers practical approaches to reduce latency in multi-threaded systems, with potential impact on high-performance services.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出带有界等待的高速多生产者多消费者队列，解决并发数据结构的关键瓶颈。此工作提供降低多线程延迟的实际方法，可能影响高性能服务的性能边界。

items.title_en: Apple Silicon Exec Explains Mac Mini AI Demand and On-Device Future
items.title_zh: 苹果芯片高管解读 Mac mini 的 AI 需求与设备端未来
items.summary_en: An Apple Silicon executive explains that AI workloads are driving demand for the Mac mini and that Apple is prioritizing on-device AI to improve privacy and latency. The note suggests the Mac mini could serve as a low-cost testbed for developers and as a stepping stone to a broader on-device AI strategy across Apple devices.
items.summary_zh: 苹果芯片高管表示，AI 工作负载推动 Mac mini 的需求增长，苹果将优先发展设备端推理以提升隐私与响应速度。Mac mini 可能成为开发者的低成本测试平台，并作为苹果在全系设备上推进设备端 AI 策略的一个起点。

items.title_en: Meta reuses old RAM in new servers with custom bridge chip
items.title_zh: Meta 在新服务器中重复利用旧 RAM，配合定制桥芯片
items.summary_en: Meta is reusing older RAM in new servers by pairing it with a custom bridge chip to cut costs and improve sustainability. The approach raises questions about reliability, performance consistency, and upgrade paths in hyperscale deployments.
items.summary_zh: Meta 在新服务器中以定制桥芯片搭配，重复利用旧RAM，降低成本并提升数据中心的可持续性。此举也引发关于可靠性、性能一致性及未来升级路径的讨论。

items.title_en: How RCA Victor sold Sound Service to classrooms in 1939
items.title_zh: 1939 年 RCA Victor 将声音服务推广到课堂
items.summary_en: A look at RCA Victor's 1939 Sound Service program, detailing how audio technology and curated content were introduced into classrooms. The historical note shows early educational tech evangelism and the challenges of scale.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 1939 年 RCA Victor 的 Sound Service 项目，描述音频技术及课程内容如何走进课堂，反映教育科技普及的早期尝试与规模化挑战。

items.title_en: Ditching Vagrant: VMs with KVM and Virsh on Debian
items.title_zh: 抛弃 Vagrant：在 Debian 上使用 KVM 与 Virsh 管理虚拟机
items.summary_en: A practical guide to ditching Vagrant in favor of KVM with virsh on Debian, covering setup, networking, and lifecycle management. Highlights performance gains and closer control over virtual environments.
items.summary_zh: 提供在 Debian 上用 KVM 与 virsh 取代 Vagrant 的实用指南，涵盖安装、网络与生命周期管理。强调性能提升与对虚拟环境的更直接掌控。

items.title_en: My Story of 3D Realms / Apogee Part I (2020)
items.title_zh: 3D Realms/Apogee 故事：第一部分（2020）
items.summary_en: A retrospective recounts the early days of PC game publisher Apogee (3D Realms), including its founding, shareware model, and impact on indie publishing. Part I frames how distribution strategies and bold risk-taking helped shape the era's PC gaming ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: 回顾 PC 游戏发行商 Apogee（3D Realms）的初创历程、分享制（shareware）商业模式及对独立游戏发行的影响。第一部分揭示了发行策略与大胆尝试如何共同塑造了那个时代的PC游戏生态。

items.title_en: The mathematical secrets of Barcelona's Sagrada Familia
items.title_zh: 巴塞罗那圣家堂的数学秘密
items.summary_en: The Sagrada Família showcases sophisticated geometry and proportional systems that guided Gaudí’s design. From curved surfaces to structural strategies, the article highlights how math underpins iconic architecture.
items.summary_zh: 圣家堂的设计大量使用复杂几何与比例体系，指引了高难度曲面与结构策略。文章揭示了数学在标志性建筑中的核心作用。

items.title_en: What is Bending Spoons? The little-known AOL and Vimeo owner that's now public
items.title_zh: Bending Spoons：这家鲜为人知的 AOL 与 Vimeo 的控股公司如今公开上市
items.summary_en: The piece explains Bending Spoons, a relatively obscure owner of AOL and Vimeo, and its path to going public. It covers the company's unusual trajectory and what its IPO could mean for the media and ad-tech landscape.
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍相对鲜为人知的 Bending Spoons，以及它如何成为 AOL 与 Vimeo 的控股方并走向上市。文章分析了该公司不寻常的成长轨迹及其首次公开发行对媒体与广告科技格局的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Life with Hazard Ratios
items.title_zh: 带着风险比的生活
items.summary_en: An accessible primer on hazard ratios, explaining how they measure relative instantaneous risk in survival analysis and how to interpret them correctly in medical studies. It contrasts hazard ratios with risk ratios, and discusses common pitfalls like non-proportional hazards, offering practical intuition for researchers and readers.
items.summary_zh: 本文对风险比（hazard ratio）进行了通俗讲解，阐明其在生存分析中衡量相对即时风险的含义以及如何在研究中正确解读。作者对比了风险比与风险相对比的区别，并讨论了如比例风险假设不成立等常见误区，为研究者提供直观的解读要点。

items.title_en: Patterncollider: Generate and explore quasiperiodic tiling patterns
items.title_zh: Patterncollider：生成与探索准周期镶嵌图案
items.summary_en: Introduces Patterncollider, a tool to generate and explore quasiperiodic tilings, enabling interactive study of non-repeating patterns like Penrose tilings. It invites mathematical exploration and potential applications in art and game design.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Patterncollider，这一工具用于生成与探索准周期镶嵌图案，支持对非重复图案（如 Penrose 镶嵌）进行交互式研究。适用于数学爱好者，以及在艺术和游戏设计中的潜在应用。

items.title_en: Triple Dragon Fractal (2020)
items.title_zh: 三龙分形（2020）
items.summary_en: Presents the Triple Dragon Fractal, a visually intricate fractal with recursive dragon-like symmetry. The piece demonstrates how simple iterative rules produce complex, self-similar visuals and invites exploration of parameter space.
items.summary_zh: 介绍三龙分形，一种具有递归式龙形对称的高复杂度分形图形。通过简单的迭代规则展示了自相似结构的美丽，并鼓励读者探索参数对图像的影响。

items.title_en: Lost city discovered beneath Egypt's desert with ancient church
items.title_zh: 埃及沙漠下发现失落城市与古教堂
items.summary_en: Archaeologists have uncovered a previously unknown city buried beneath the Egyptian desert, along with an ancient church. The find sheds light on urban life and early Christian presence in the region, illustrating how desert geology can preserve antiquities for study. It also hints at trade routes and cultural exchange in ancient Egypt.
items.summary_zh: 考古学家在埃及沙漠下发现一座未知的失落城市，以及一座古老教堂。此发现揭示了该地区早期城市生活与基督教早期足迹，说明沙漠地质对文物保存的重要性，同时也指向古代埃及的贸易网络与文化交流。

items.title_en: Common prefix skipping, adaptive sort
items.title_zh: 常用前缀跳跃的自适应排序
items.summary_en: Describes an adaptive sorting technique that leverages common prefixes to skip redundant comparisons, speeding up sorts on data with shared beginnings.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了一种自适应排序法，通过跳过公共前缀来避免重复比较，从而提升具有共同前缀数据的排序性能。文中给出实际要点，讨论在何时使用前缀跳跃以及它与缓存行为的关系。

items.title_en: Cache-Conscious Data Layout in Rust: Field Zoning, False Sharing, 128-Byte Rule
items.title_zh: Rust 中的缓存感知数据布局：字段分区、伪共享与 128 字节规则
items.summary_en: A deep dive into cache-conscious data layout in Rust, focusing on field zoning to reduce false sharing and the 128-byte cache-line guideline. The post offers practical layout patterns, illustrating performance gains in concurrent and memory-bound scenarios.
items.summary_zh: 深入探讨 Rust 的缓存感知数据布局，聚焦字段分区以降低伪共享，并遵循 128 字节缓存行的准则。文中给出实用的布局模式，并展示在并发与内存绑定场景中的性能提升。

items.title_en: Alternate Clock Designs and Time Systems
items.title_zh: 替代时钟设计与时间系统
items.summary_en: The piece surveys unconventional clock designs and timekeeping ideas, weighing pros and cons of decimal time or alternative calendars. It shows how time design shapes software, culture, and human routines.
items.summary_zh: 文章概览了非传统的时钟设计与时间系统，评估十进制时间等替代日历的利弊，展示时间设计如何影响软件、文化和日常生活。

items.title_en: Harman and Dr. Sean Olive are reshaping headphone sound (2025)
items.title_zh: Harman 与 Dr. Sean Olive 正在重新塑造耳机声音（2025）
items.summary_en: Harman and Dr. Sean Olive are continuing to shape the sound profile of headphones, grounding tuning in measurement-driven psychoacoustics and the Harman Curve. The piece sheds light on how industry-standard targets influence product design, marketing, and listener expectations in 2025.
items.summary_zh: Harman 与 Dr. Sean Olive 正在通过以测量驱动的心理声学方法，持续塑造耳机的听感轮廓，并以常见的 Harman 曲线为行业参考。这一进展揭示了标准目标如何影响产品设计、市场定位及听者预期。

items.title_en: Damaged Earth Catalog
items.title_zh: 受损地球目录
items.summary_en: A catalog that collates images and data portraying environmental damage to Earth, offering a stark visual record of climate and ecological degradation.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份汇集了地球环境损伤的图像与数据的目录，直观呈现气候与生态恶化的冷酷记录。

items.title_en: Ancient Coins: What About Spartan Coins?
items.title_zh: 古代硬币：斯巴达币制何物
items.summary_en: Examines Spartan coinage, its metallurgy, and political messaging, offering insight into how coin design reflected power and trade in ancient Greece.
items.summary_zh: 分析斯巴达的铸币制度、金属成分与政治宣示，揭示币制如何映射古希腊的权力结构与贸易网络。
